summary: Tested Lab page redesign for ChessGuru. Fixed backend bug (decryption_v5_data being list instead of dict). All features verified: verdict strip with W/L and behavioral insight, Coach's Pick with meaningful pick_reason, game rows with lesson_label badges and behavioral text, mark as reviewed functionality, navigation to game review page.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in server.py line 5131: decryption_v5_data was sometimes a list instead of dict, causing AttributeError
Verdict strip correctly shows W/L record (1W 3L) and behavioral insight ('2 games thrown from winning positions')
Coach's Pick shows opponent name, result badge, opening, and meaningful pick_reason referencing actual patterns
Game rows display accuracy dot (colored), opponent, result badge, opening, lesson_label badge, and behavioral text
Reviewed section shows games with reduced opacity and lesson labels
Mark as reviewed button appears on hover and correctly moves games to reviewed section
All navigation works: Coach's Pick → /game/{id}, game rows → /game/{id}, Import button → /import
seed_data_creation: Used existing 5 seeded test games: vs GrandMaster42 (L), BlitzKing99 (W), QuietPawn (L), SicilianFan (L, reviewed), EndgameNerd (D, reviewed)
